summary.text: Julia Greenfield is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 100, which she has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Julia Greenfield grew up in Charlotte, North Carolina, and graduated from Garinger High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Appalachian State University and a nursing degree from Central Piedmont Community College.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse and stay-at-home mother, and as of 2024 she was affiliated with the Charlotte Jewish Day School and the Levine Jewish Community Center.
